title: Strict Minor/Patch Dependency Pinning (Dependency Strife)
damaged_code:
```rust
# Cargo.toml containing highly pinned version requirement
hugs = "=1.7.3" # Restricts cargo's version solver unnecessarily
```
pattern: Specifying strict, exact version constraints on common dependency packages (e.g. `=1.7.3`) in library crates.
why_bad: It triggers diamond dependency failures. If a higher-level consumer uses another crate that relies on a different minor version of the same library, the package manager SAT-solver gives up.
detection: An exact match constraint (`=`) or restrictive minor match used on shared utility packages in library configuration files.
counterexample: Pinning dependencies in a top-level binary deployment manifest to ensure identical production builds.
fix: Use looser, compatible version constraints (e.g. `^1.7` or `1`) to allow the package manager to find compatible versions.
